{
  "name": "keyfob",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "API tokens for Claude Code, your shell and your scripts: kept in the macOS Keychain, the Linux Secret Service or a 0600 file on servers, handed to one command at a time; Claude asks for a secret by name and /keyfob opens on it with a masked field, so the value never becomes a message; a guard stops commands that would print one; plugins declare what they need in keyfob.json, optional members included",
  "author": {
    "name": "Shiran Yu",
    "url": "https://github.com/yushiran"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/yushiran/keyfob",
  "repository": "https://github.com/yushiran/keyfob",
  "license": "CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0",
  "keywords": [
    "secrets",
    "api-keys",
    "tokens",
    "keychain",
    "secret-service",
    "security"
  ]
}
